_comment: Brain profiles. Copy to config/brains.json and edit. Select with WIKI_BRAIN=<name>|auto and WIKI_BRAIN_DATA=public|personal|company|private (default company). 'data' = the data classes this brain may receive: company = company documents, personal = your own notes, private = notes marked private (diary...), public = public material. A brain not listed for a class is NEVER used for it, not even as a fallback. 'cost': lower is tried first in auto mode (0 = free/local). Keys: only files (api_key_file), relative paths are relative to this file. Each brain sees ONLY its own settings (nothing is inherited). Check with: python -m llmwiki.brains list

gemini._comment: Google's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (UNVERIFIED here: check the address and model id in Google's docs). Sends text to Google: allow only what your policy allows. On-site company documents: ask security first (leave 'company' out until approved).
